name: fourforces
title: fourforces
blurb: QWOP but Q/W/O/P dial the four fundamental forces, and the hillside is a live Conway-family cellular automaton whose ruleset follows whichever force is winning. Mash P too long and it all collapses to a point. @norvid-studies.bsky.social tagged the bot at the end of a thread that spec'd this out one absurd reply at a time.
